title: 老洋房里喝手冲：广州东山口 | Coffee in Guangzhou's Old Villas ☕
description:
东山少爷、西关小姐——你更想住在哪一边？评论区聊聊。

广州东山口曾是达官显贵和归国华侨的聚居地，至今保留着六百多栋民国红砖洋房，是广州首批历史文化保护区之一。如今，这些老洋房里开满了独立咖啡馆，一杯慢慢滴滤的手冲，配上百年砖墙的光影。老广有句话：得闲饮咖啡。

Dongshankou in Guangzhou was once home to officials and returned overseas-Chinese families. Its 600-plus Republican-era red-brick villas — one of the city's first protected heritage districts — are now full of independent cafés. Order a slow hand-pour and sip it against century-old brick. As locals say in Cantonese: 得闲饮咖啡 — "free? come for a coffee."

粤语彩蛋 / Cantonese: 「得闲饮咖啡」(from 得闲饮茶). 老广谚语 / saying: 「东山少爷，西关小姐」.

AI-assisted edit; footage licensed from Pexels (credited below). Subtitles are the narration — no voiceover.
